summary: Confirmed the controller diagnosis byte-for-byte: tests/caller-classification.test.mjs at d8dec41 held exactly one raw NUL byte (offset 7649, inside a Mozilla/NUL/repeat(4000) probe array on source line 143) and no other control byte. Replaced the raw NUL with the six-character JS escape for U+0000 (same string value), and no other byte in the file. file(1) now reports the path as UTF-8 text, not data. node --test runs 17/17, unchanged. Built an isolated scratch copy of the classifier plus this test and mutated the callerIdentity() fallback branch the NUL probe falls into; the suite dropped to 14/17, proving the tests actually discriminate on that path; the real tracked functions/mcp.js was never touched. Committed only tests/caller-classification.test.mjs on lane/t3b-tests-g99 with a message citing C409 D2; git diff d8dec41 --stat lists exactly that one path. One material caveat: git diff d8dec41 --numstat still reports the pair as binary after the fix, because git's binary-blob heuristic evaluates both sides of a diff and the OLD side (d8dec41's blob) still contains the original NUL forever in history; this is a general git property (reproduced on two throwaway files outside this repo) and cannot be changed without rewriting history, which is out of this allocation's scope. What is fixed and verified: the blob at HEAD contains zero NUL/control bytes, and every diff computed from this commit forward (confirmed against a scratch one-line edit) renders as ordinary text with real line counts. Whether GitHub's PR view specifically now shows this fix commit as non-binary against d8dec41, or shows the file as readable text going forward, was not directly observed because this allocation forbids push/network -- hence NEEDS_VERIFY rather than a clean pass.

Reproduced the same git behavior on two disposable non-repo files (one with a raw NUL, one without) to confirm this is general git behavior, not something specific to this fix.

What the fix does verifiably change: the blob committed at HEAD (d48d947) contains zero NUL or other control bytes, and any diff computed from this commit forward (tested by diffing HEAD's fixed content against a scratch copy with one appended line) renders as an ordinary text diff with real line counts and a normal @@ hunk header, not a binary-files message. GitHub's own rendering of this specific commit against d8dec41, and of the raw file view, was not observed directly since pushing is out of scope for this allocation.
